name: Solid FEM
description: Mesh a part, set a material, fixed faces and loads (force, pressure, gravity) by picking faces in the 3D view, and solve a linear static or modal study with the CadCraft finite element library. Displacement, von Mises stress, reactions and frequencies are drawn on the model, with a warning list. Linear elastic only. Not a code check; your engineer reviews the results.
author: CadCraft
honesty: Linear small-displacement analysis with isotropic materials. Checked against closed-form answers (cantilever, Lame cylinder, patch test) and against PartCraft's own Simulation solver on the same mesh; not compared with any other program. Not a code check.
